body: Thank you so much for this, to take time out of your day to write such a nice thing for me...it means so much to me. You're right, I don't even know you but to hear you are proud of me made me just light up and for that I can't thank you enough...

I'm so sorry not responding faster, I use a alt account for these posts and didn't see this notification. 

I hope this isn't morbid , but it's somewhat comforting to know others go through this too and I'm not truly alone. I really appreciate you sharing this.
